questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Only proceed when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns of a school zone. It may indicate a school crossing where children and other pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to watch for pedestrians and cyclists in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. When you see this sign, you must drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you of hazards ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and prepare for a sudden, sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid losing control and damaging your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of hazards. Orange is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic rules you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that the right lane is ending. Be prepared for traffic merging.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead may be slippery when wet.
